title: Sheng-Yun Brian Yu CV
subtitle: Tech Lead · 8 years in backend and platform engineering; led an 11-person cross-functional team; iterating faster with AI-assisted development

description.intro:
Hello, I am Sheng-Yun Yu (Brian Yu), a tech lead with around 8 years of experience, focused on raising team delivery through AI collaboration. At a gaming and live-streaming platform I led an 11-person cross-functional team, owning the microservice architecture and the team's development standards.

Over the past year, AI-assisted development has been my primary way of working. At Feeling Bank, as a sole engineer working with AI agents, I delivered two product lines in six months and shipped six Claude features. At Pacificsmart, I led the real-time AI interpretation platform Abestar Live from POC to production and introduced AI agents into the team's task dispatch, code review, and deployment workflows.

My method is to define completion criteria as automatically verifiable checks before handing implementation to agents, balancing delivery speed with quality.
